title: Tom Farmer, CIA general counsel, vetting Paperclip Germans

tellings.quote: I was going to say it turned out he was involved in in the project called Paperclip.

plain: Tom Farmer, a lawyer who served as the CIA's general counsel, is said to have helped vet the German scientists brought to the United States after the Second World War under Paperclip, the secret programme that recruited them. Harold Malmgren, a former presidential adviser, tells this on the show from what he learned of Farmer, saying 'it turned out he was involved in the project called Paperclip'. It matters to him because it ties a man he knew to the programme that brought German expertise into American secret work.
